articles.summary: MOLINE, Ill., Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - QCR Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: QCRH) (the “Company”) today announced that on November 18, 2026, the Company’s Board of Directors declared a cash dividend of $0.15 per share payable on January 6, 2027, to stockholders of record on December 22, 2026. About Us QCR Holdings, Inc., headquartered in Moline, Illinois, is a relationship-driven, multi-bank holding company serving the Quad Cities, Cedar Rapids, Cedar Valley, Des Moines/Ankeny and Springfield communities through its wholly owned subsidiary banks. The banks provide full-service commercial and consumer banking and trust and wealth management services. articles.summary: MOLINE, Ill., Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - QCR Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: QCRH) (the “Company”) today announced that its subsidiary, Cedar Rapids Bank Trust Company, has entered into a definitive agreement with BankIowa, based in Cedar Rapids, Iowa, to sell its Community Bank Trust division, which consists of three branch locations serving the Waterloo-Cedar Falls metropolitan area. The transaction includes two branches located in Waterloo, Iowa, and one branch located in Cedar Falls, Iowa. The sale includes certain deposits and loans associated with the three branches, totaling approximately $140 million and $29 million, respectively, as of September 30, 2026.
